component.name: StreamResolver
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetUrl(m.top.apiBase + "/api/roku/resolve/" + m.top.channelId) xfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") xfer.InitClientCertificates() xfer.SetRequest("GET") resp = xfer.GetToString() if resp = invalid or resp = "" m.top.error = "Could not resolve stream" return end if data = ParseJson(resp) if data = invalid or data.stream_url = invalid or data.stream_url = "" if data <> invalid and data.detail <> invalid m.top.error = data.detail else m.top.error = "No playable stream for this channel yet" end if return end if m.top.result = data end sub
